verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows RevenueCat's core subscription infrastructure (entitlements, offerings, paywalls, webhooks, exports) but contains no mention of dunning-specific features like branded recovery emails, in-app banners, configurable grace periods, or cancel-vs-unpaid final-state rules. A community comment even requests exactly this kind of timed-notification/dunning hook as a missing feature, reinforcing the absence of evidence for it.
